title: Network rerun handoff foundation
summary: Phase 4A will add the config/state foundation for Network CSV rerun handoff paths without enabling worker row claims.
reason: Network CSV rerun rows cannot safely reach workers until the coordinator can prove a dedicated handoff root and per-row handoff folders are valid and isolated from source, final-output, LocalBase, and pending-publish state.
behavior_before: Network CSV rerun preview/start evidence reports output handoff as not configured, and confirmed network batches keep rows claim-disabled without planned handoff folders.
behavior_after: Network CSV rerun preview, dry-run, and confirmed batch state will carry validated NetworkRerunHandoffRoot evidence and per-row planned handoff folders, while worker claims remain disabled.
tests_added: tests.python.desktop.test_rerun_csv_preview: NetworkRerunHandoffRoot preview readiness, per-row handoff templates, and coordinator probe cleanup.
tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_process_launch: Network CSV rerun start dry-run handoff blockers and confirmed batch state handoff evidence.
tests.python.desktop.test_service_config_validation: unsafe configured NetworkRerunHandoffRoot roots rejected for relative, source, output, LocalBase, and Pending Publish overlap.
manual_validation: PASS: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --paths <Phase 4A touched paths> (0 written, 21 unchanged across two targeted runs)

KNOWN PREEXISTING GAP: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --check reports unrelated missing/stale summaries outside Phase 4A.
rollback_plan: Remove the NetworkRerunHandoffRoot config exposure, handoff validation helpers, preview/dry-run/start handoff evidence, tests, docs, and generated summaries. Existing Phase 1-3 network CSV rerun routes should remain read-only or claim-disabled.
notes:
Phase 4A scope: config/state foundation only. Do not enable worker row claims, do not process media, do not write final output, and do not mutate PendingServerPush.
D1 distributed unit: row claim remains the target unit, but Phase 4A only plans per-row handoff folders and leaves rows unclaimable.
D2 batch authority: State/Rerun/Network/<batch_id>.json remains coordinator-owned batch/row authority; preview and dry-run carry planned handoff evidence before confirmed state writes.
D3 destination authority: coordinator reducer remains the only future owner for final promotion, pending publish, replacement, review, and rejection.
D4 handoff contract: add NetworkRerunHandoffRoot; per-row path shape is <NetworkRerunHandoffRoot>/<batch_id>/<row_key>/; remote workers require UNC/shared handoff paths, while local-drive roots are coordinator-local only; the root must not overlap source roots, Outsource, LibraryProfiles.output_path, LocalBase, or pending-publish state.
D5 source mapping: keep existing library_id plus safe relative_path preference and WorkerSourcePathMap fallback; Phase 4A must not add worker-local CSV interpretation.
D6 lifecycle: active batch still blocks close-readiness; rows remain claim-disabled until Phase 4B.
D7 evidence: preview/dry-run/start should report handoff readiness, blockers, planned root/folder, and no-write/no-media effects; worker result artifact fields are deferred to Phase 4B.
D8 operator surface: no WebView start/progress controls in this phase unless existing payload rendering requires static updates.
Validation rung: settings/config validation, read-route/command dry-run tests, confirmed-start state tests, path-boundary tests, and strict change-packet coverage. No real-media validation required because Phase 4A remains config/state only.
